title: Every irreducible subset lies in an irreducible component; the components cover the space
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space. Every irreducible subset $T\subseteq X$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] is contained in some irreducible component of $X$. In particular every point $x\in X$ lies in some irreducible component of $X$ (apply this to the irreducible subset $\{x\}$), that is, $X$ is the union of its irreducible components.
